description: This file implements a text-based progress display module for GIT, including progress tracking, throughput calculation, and display functions.

classes.name: throughput
classes.description: Structure for tracking throughput metrics such as total bytes, misecs, and display buffer.

classes.name: progress
classes.description: Structure for tracking progress state, including repository info, title, total work, throughput, and display buffers.

methods.name: progress_test_force_update
methods.description: Forces a progress update for testing purposes.

methods.name: start_delayed_progress
methods.description: Starts a progress indicator with a delay.

methods.name: start_progress
methods.description: Starts a progress indicator without delay.

methods.name: start_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts a sparse progress indicator that may sample updates.

methods.name: start_delayed_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts a sparse progress indicator with delay.

methods.name: stop_progress_msg
methods.description: Stops the progress indicator and displays a final message.
